planets.name: K2-37 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-37 with a 14.1-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-37 d was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-37. Its orbit and size follow Howard et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
